title: New Zealand VLOG: 2 Weeks Roadtripping the South Island | Queenstown, Milford Sound, Wānaka & More
description:
New Zealand has been my #1 bucket list destination for as long as I can remember — and it delivered in every possible way. This is our full South Island adventure: Christchurch, Lake Tekapo, Wānaka, Queenstown, Milford Sound, and everything in between. I hope you have fun watching 🤍
